lines.intro: Second Look. A second pair of eyes that shows its working.
lines.problem: Most AI reviewers leave a pile of comments. One of them matters. Which one?
lines.paste: Paste a pull request. It checks out the branch in its own worktree, reads your docs, and never edits anything.
lines.intent: Before any review, it reads the ticket and the design, sums up the intent, and asks you only what the code can't answer.
lines.review: Then you walk the change together. Steps are routed by risk. Every finding carries evidence, and a second agent tries to prove it wrong before you see it.
lines.post: You decide. Accept, park, or reject. Only what you accept is posted, written like a teammate, under your name.
lines.features: Self-hosted, on your own keys. Connect Jira, Figma, or any MCP server. Or nothing at all.
lines.outro: Second Look. Run it on your machine.
